applicabilityBasis.summary: Minteo describes COPM as a transferable digital Colombian peso, backed by COP reserves and redeemable 1:1 by approved customers. Its payment and settlement purpose supports this research classification; no U.S. offer or permission is inferred.

genius.notes: Review dated November 15 2026. The BDO reserve report identifies Minteo as WAGMI S.A.S. in Colombia. Issuer compliance material establishes AML/KYC procedures but does not identify a token-specific U.S. GENIUS approval, application or foreign-issuer registration. The public monthly report series is present, with reporting lag recorded separately by the canonical reserve-report metadata. No partner license, general regulatory-alignment statement or bank-custody assertion is treated as COPM issuance authorization. MiCA remains unassessed because reviewed sources do not establish an EU offering, authorization or exact-token restriction.
